owner_approval_gates.name: Source identity and exact version
owner_approval_gates.proof: Source commit+blob SHA, canonical object role, authoritative institution and historical date

owner_approval_gates.name: Complete Registry human/JSON semantic field pairs
owner_approval_gates.proof: Every Registry owner field assessed in its human output or documented controlled omission with source path

owner_approval_gates.name: Complete Certifier SCRD human/JSON semantic field pairs
owner_approval_gates.proof: Every derived SCRD field assessed against SCRD human output, separately from its canonical Certification Package

owner_approval_gates.name: Cross-institution source-at-use facts
owner_approval_gates.proof: Owner-approved source-to-SREG mapping for all semantically shared values and supported exceptions

owner_approval_gates.name: Authority boundary and unsupported equivalence
owner_approval_gates.proof: No auto-assumed equality between unrelated issuer and Registry fields; native registers kept independent

owner_approval_gates.name: Current state and served bytes
owner_approval_gates.proof: Separately authorized live read-only source verification with provenance/time and stable served representation

owner_approval_gates.name: History and correction continuity
owner_approval_gates.proof: Registry/Certifier historical state and corrections preserved without rewriting prior versions

owner_approval_gates.name: Institutional disposition
owner_approval_gates.proof: Named Certifier, Registry and applicable Atlas/Suite owners independently approve or reject exceptions
